name: Ayódar (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ayódar (a holm oak on rocks on white).
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 15 April 1999 of the conseller de Presidència, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana; it is a flag of 2:3, white, with the municipal arms (approved 26 June 1996, the holm oak on rocks being the traditional arms of the locality) at the centre.

features.role: Ayódar arms — holm oak on rocks
